rows: Oh, hello. I am nervous, but I am also really excited.
Brawling is a bit scary, but I will try it.
A risk is a bit frightening, and I think that is the point.
Slow is good, my heart cannot take it any faster.
The people are so kind, I hope I do them proud.
I am nervous and excited, both at once.
I have been practising the flips in my head all week.
Look at my stance. My knees are shaking, but I am ready.
You talk about technique. Mine is still new, I am afraid.
Strikes are scary, but I want to try mine.
A risk is a leap, and I am trying not to look down.
A stall would be a relief, honestly, but I will not do it.
The people want something amazing. I hope I can give them that.
You say you are among the best. That makes me nervous.
You are proud of your strength. I am jealous, a little.
I have noticed your strength, and it looks wonderful.
You kept calm. I wish I could do that.
Fair. You are right, and I am a bit flustered.
I could argue, but my voice is shaking.
One fall. Please, let it be a good one.
On the mat, I will try to keep my balance. Please be patient.
Grounded or standing, I am still trying my best.
Stay in front of me, and I will try not to trip.
Good answer. That helps my nerves a little.
You have not answered. I will wait, and try not to fidget.
Fair point. I will remember it, promise.
I accept that. I hope the bell does not come too soon.
I will give this match everything, even if my hands shake.
My approach is brave, even if I am scared. You will see it on the night.
Whatever happens, I hope the crowd enjoys it.
It is not finished. I am still hoping for a good moment.
I have one more trick. I hope it works when the bell rings.
